train972.target_encoding: single-channel WT labels1/2/3; label4 collapsed with ordinary background

interpretation: The models were exposed to many RC-containing training scans, so the failure is not simple absence of RC cases. Binary WT supervision collapses RC and ordinary background, while WAW early-postop has higher RC prevalence and most point misses land in RC. This supports a supervision-representation gap but does not prove a multi-class RC head will improve WT or point hit.
future_requirement: Any explicit RC/CSF/surgery-aware model changes output and loss; it requires a new train-only development role, preregistration, matched control, and unseen validation before external access.
forbidden_use: no GT-RC avoidance, no current-cohort postprocessing, no claim that RC head is proven, no retraining without new evidence
